zh: 聊天框宠物新增随插件发布的 Cindy：取自开源应用 Cindy 的岛屿伙伴原画（Apache-2.0），保留与 Petdex 相同的状态与手势，沿用「聊天框宠物包」的同一处选择。
en: Add Cindy to the chat pet choices, shipped with the plugin: the island companion drawn for the open-source app Cindy (Apache-2.0), keeping the same states and gestures a Petdex pet answers, picked from the same Chat pet package select.
